assessment_scope: Two original small synthetic drawing tasks; one fresh-context model execution per plugin version, including autonomous pre-freeze corrections.
author_oracle_origin: Original design parameters and independent Decimal hand formulas; no production QTO result was consulted.
conclusion: Both versions completed both requested bounded tasks with correct physical-span quantities and drawing interpretations. No demonstrated accuracy improvement between versions.
limitations: Original synthetic drawings with clear text and supported geometry; no real-project accuracy or generalization claim.
One run per version and case; no causal attribution of outcome or speed to the policy changes.
Model access isolation followed the task protocol; archived declarations, timestamps and hashes do not independently prove hidden-context blindness.
Original author reference is now published in this archive; these cases are regression material for any future reader, not a fresh blind holdout.
Native validators prove contracts and encoded invariants; engineering conclusions here are separately judged against the independent design.
This selected archive does not include all files in the original freeze lists, full plugin snapshots, full model conversations, or HTML/browser sessions.
The tested candidate snapshot precedes later rebar fixes and wording changes; those later changes were not rerun through this model trial.
mapping_policy: Original reference identifiers are unchanged. After freezing, legitimate geometric primitive splits were grouped by the same physical spans. Units m²/m2 and source-specific wording for the same requested net-finish basis were explicitly normalized; no quantity was altered.

actual_errors_and_recovery.independent_scope_judgment: No model-space INSERT uses that definition. Requested geometry is readable and all author-required quantities are present. Keep diagnostic; do not relabel full parsing as PASS.

actual_errors_and_recovery.recovery: A new v2 input supplied the explicit binding policy before freeze; original rejection retained. Geometry, quantities and DN choices were not fitted to reference.

actual_errors_and_recovery.observed: Minimum-result validation first rejected confirmed quantities using trial rules, then rejected ASM- assumption IDs.
actual_errors_and_recovery.recovery: Final v3 delivery retains working/reference status with A- IDs, passes minimum validation; native numerical output unchanged.
